description: Buu's house: a white round house like a lying caterpillar, with a big head dome, four round segments trailing to the right, and a long round tube lying on top, fattest in the middle, with its flat front to the front left.
layout: Middle: the lower body lies along x, straight on the ground with no stone base: a big white head and four round segments to its right. The head is a lying egg, long and round at the same time: its round left end is at x -3.39, about 0.4 above the ground; it is highest (1.5) at x -1.99, 0.6 of its visible length, and 2.3 deep. Its axis runs along x at 0.4 high, so its lower part is under the ground. Its back half (1.6 long) goes into segment 1 and ends at x -0.39: at the joint (x -0.99) the head is about as high as segment 1, so it shows 2.4 of its length. The segment heights rise from segment 1 to segment 3, and the tail is the smallest: segment 1 x -0.99 to 0.61 (1.25 high), segment 2 x 0.11 to 1.81 (1.38), segment 3 x 1.31 to 3.11 (1.48), tail x 2.61 to 4.01 (1). Each segment presses 0.5 into the next: they join. Front left: two long pointed fins lie on the ground under the round left end of the head, each a dome laid on its side with its base hidden in the head: one in front points to the front left (25 degrees), one behind points left; they are 0.46 thick and stick out about 0.4 and 0.6 to the left of the head. Top: a long round white tube lies on the head, 3.9 long. It runs to the back right, 47 degrees from x, and its back end rises 7 degrees. Its front is cut flat, like a sausage cut with a knife: a full flat round face, 1.06 wide, at the front left (center x -3.03, z 0.77, about 1.97 high). Nothing comes out of it and it is not hollow. Right behind the cut the tube is already nearly full (1.56 wide at 0.4 m), then it swells to its fattest part, 1.7 wide, in the middle (x -1.61, z -0.75), then ends in a big round back. It is a short front egg and a main egg (each 2 domes back to back, laid along the tube); the cut face is the flat base of a dome pointing back, whose rest is hidden inside. Its lowest point is 0.14 into the top of the head, so it sits on the head; its back hangs over segment 1, 0.66 above it. The round door hole on the head, the hole in the cut face of the tube, and all the small round windows are not shapes: they will be painted in textures.
